Both the kmesh and kfmesh ibz_path can only be calculated if ibz_path is set.  These two objects require a bit of internal structure to be read correctly: The memory layout is:

  • N (number of segments, index_t)

  • lengh_segment_0 (index_t)

  • …

  • length_segment_N

  • M (number of points, index_t)

  • index_point_0 (index_t)

  • …

  • index_point_M

  • point_0_x (double)

  • point_0_y

  • point_0_z

  • …

  • point_M_x

  • point_M_y

  • point_M_z

Note that [displ, size] accounts for the full displacement and size of the memory layout described above

if ibz_path is set, else all the following are zero

bandstructure [displ, size]

header[127]: bit field (64bits) that is all zero when the numerical representations are correct. if not, errors are indicated in the following manner:

  • the leftmost (first) bit is one when floats are not represented in iec559

  • the second bit is one when doubles are not represented in iec559

  • the third bit is one when integers (int and index_t) are not little endian

  • the fourth bit is one when 1 byte (sizeof(char)) is not the same as 8 bit.

diverge_model_output_conf_t
typedef struct
diverge_model_output_conf_t

to have fine-grained output control over diverge_model_to_file

Members (all integers interpreted as bool if not specified else):

kc

coarse kmesh

kf

fine kmesh

kc_ibz_path

include the indices on the coarse mesh that describe the ibz path. must have model->n_ibz_path > 0.

kf_ibz_path

include the indices on the fine mesh that describe the ibz path. must have model->n_ibz_path > 0.

H

Hamiltonian on fine mesh

U

Orbital to band matrices on fine mesh

E

energies on fine mesh

npath

integer. use this as the number of points on the IBZ path (cf.  diverge_model_output_set_npath). Only used when nonzero; but then with precedence over what is/has been set in diverge_model_output_set_npath. possible nonzero values: -1, >=1.

offers the same functionality as diverge_model_to_file including fine-grained controls over all internal structures. Returns the md5sum of the written file as static string.

const char*

diverge_model_output_set_npath
void diverge_model_output_set_npath(
int 
npath
)

set the number of points per IBZ segment for the bandstructure calculation.  defaults to DIVERGE_MODEL_NBANDSTRUCTURE (300). must be called before diverge_model_to_file. If set to -1, use diverge_kmesh_to_bands on the internal energy array and do not generate a band structure. requires common internals to be set (due to the energy array).
